cool.description: Something is stylish or approved of.

honestly.description: Opener that signals a candid opinion.

seriously.description: Emphatic opener or intensifier: I mean it.

agree.description: A one-word reply that means yes, I agree.

lying.description: Someone is not telling the truth.

no_lie.description: Swearing that what follows is true.

resembles.description: It resembles or evokes something ("it's giving").

friend.description: A close friend, often as a form of address.

drama.description: Gossip, conflict, or the juicy story.

jealous.description: Envious or bitter about someone else.

main_character.description: Acting like the protagonist; the center of attention.

disbelief.description: Scoffing disbelief: as if that would happen.

overreacting.description: Freaking out, acting irrationally or having a meltdown.

dismiss.description: Dismissive brush-off: stop talking, I don't want to hear it.

delusional.description: Unrealistically hopeful or in denial, often playfully.

doomed.description: Failed or about to face the consequences.

food_tax.plain: taking a bite of your food
food_tax.description: Jokingly swiping some of a friend's food.

overpraising.description: Complimenting someone far too much, usually insincerely.

carpe_diem.description: Make the most of the moment; take the risk.

adulting.description: Handling adult responsibilities, usually with a wink.
